review_description: The companies who called could only book appointments 3 to 4 weeks away and they were not very organised with thier appointment times. No reminders and no one showed at the exact time they said they would apart from one company. Did not think any of these companies wanted my business. there was also no follow up after quote. Solar assist attended to us in the evening and have been in contact every week since to ensure we are happy with installation times and service so far.
